run.name: Transalta Corp
run.title: CP-OS host session (TAC)
run.summary: Ample liquidity of 1,867 and hedged, part-contracted cash flows support the credit, but leverage of 4.1 times is above target, the earnings base has narrowed, and October 2026 transactions change the debt in ways not yet measurable. Launched through CP-OS as of 2026-11-05 on the retained context; the EDGAR registrant name in that context is TRANSALTA CORP.

leverage.basis: Total debt / EBITDA. Total debt 4,220 = 3,470 plus 750; net of cash 345 gives 3,875. LTM Adjusted EBITDA 1,006 (non-IFRS, includes Energy Transition, excludes Centralia Order costs). Company ratio 4.1 on Adjusted Net Debt 4,121 which adds 50 per cent of preferred shares. Excludes post-quarter Colorado debt; restricted cash not deducted.

gaps: Host session: an agent answered every module from the pinned filings and CP-5 is its own review. No independent review has been made. Treat the analysis as candidate.
CP-2 main limitation: No audited FY2025 statements, covenant levels, instrument terms or transaction agreements; several measures are management-defined.
CP-1 main limitation: Management-defined measures; no audited FY2025 statements, covenant levels or instrument terms.
